error_profile.loses: Tatlı ile tuzlu arası tat ve susuzluğu giderme açıklamalarını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Su türü çekirdeğini ve insanların elinin erişmiş olması açıklamasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün tatlı ile tuzlu su arasındaki bir su olarak açıklandığı kaynak bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.loses: El değmesi ve susuzluğu giderme açıklamalarını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Su türü çekirdeğini ve tatlı ile tuzlu arasındaki tat özelliğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Sözün içenin susuzluğunu giderip onu ferahlattığı açıklamaya bağlı kaynak bağlamına özgüdür.

error_profile.loses: El değmesi ve tatlı ile tuzlu arası tat açıklamalarını dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Su türü çekirdeğini ve susuzluğu giderme işlevini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Kapsam genel olarak suya değil, kaynaklarda farklı biçimlerde açıklanan belirli su adına ve onun üç ayrı yorumuna bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü aynı su adını üç ayrı açıklamayla verir: ellerin eriştiği su, tatlı ile tuzlu arasındaki su ve susuzluğu gideren su. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu açıklamalar tek bir özellikmiş gibi birleştirilemez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Sözlükselleşme durumu çözümsüz bırakılır; tanım çıplak bir kök anlamı varsaymaz ve yalnız kaynakta verilen su adı açıklamalarını sunar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kaynaklar arasındaki iki belirgin açıklama farkını sınayan su dalları okur için en yararlı karşılaştırmaları sağlar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme yalnız tatlı ile tuzlu arasındaki su açıklamasındadır; bu dalın öteki kaynak açıklamaları komşuda yoktur, komşunun isteksiz içme vurgusu da bu dalda zorunlu değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ayrıca el değmesi ve susuzluğu giderme yönünde iki bağımsız kaynak açıklaması taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal suyun isteksizce içilmesini ve tadının hoş bulunmamasını açıkça içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, tatlılığı azalmış veya tuzluluğu belirginleşmiş içme suyu alanında örtüşür.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Örtüşme yalnız susuzluğu gideren su açıklamasındadır; bu dal bir su adına bağlıyken komşu dal içme ve doyurma sürecini daha geniş kapsamda anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ayrıca el değmiş su ve tatlı ile tuzlu arası su açıklamalarını taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal susuzluğu giderme eylemini ve doyana kadar içmeyi daha geniş biçimde kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal, suyun susuzluğu giderip içeni ferahlatması alanında örtüşür.

branches.source_phrase_ar: المسوس من الماء ما نالته الأيدي (maqayis)؛ المسوس من المياه ما نالته الأيدي (ayn)؛ المسوس من الماء الذي بين العذب والملح (sihah)؛ المسوس الذي يمس الغلة فيشفيها وكل ما شفى الغليل (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aynı su adını tanımlar, fakat ayırt edici özelliğinde birleşmez: el değmesi, tatlılık ile tuzluluk arası tat ve susuzluğu giderme ayrı açıklamalardır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه اسم الماء المسوس كما عرفته المصادر: ما نالته الأيدي، أو ما كان بين العذب والملح، أو ما يمس الغلة فيشفيها.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس فرعا عاما لكل ماء، ولا النحاس المسمى مسا.

concept_gloss.applicability: Karşılıklı fiziksel dokunmanın reddedildiği, yasaklandığı veya olmayacağının bildirildiği kalıp kullanımlarına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılıklılığı, fiziksel dokunmayı ve bunun olumsuzlanmasını birlikte korur.

concept_map.definition: Kişilerin birbirine dokunmasını reddetmek, yasaklamak veya bundan kaçınmayı bildirmektir.

facets.statement: Taraflar arasında karşılıklı dokunma olmayacağı olumsuz bir kalıpla bildirilir.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Dokunmanın kesin biçimde reddedildiği veya yasaklandığı kısa ve doğrudan söyleyişlerde uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Dokunma eylemini ve bu eylemin kesin biçimde olumsuzlanmasını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal bağımsız bir dokunma adı değil, birbirine dokunmama anlamını kuran olumsuz anlatımla sınırlıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, kalıplaşmış olumsuz anlatımın karşılıklı dokunmayı reddettiğini veya yasakladığını açıkça belirtir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnızca olumsuz kalıp içinde dokunmanın reddedilmesine bağlıdır; olumlu fiziksel dokunma anlamına genellenmez.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; olumlu dokunma dalıyla kurulan karşıtlık, kalıbın olumsuzluk sınırını en doğrudan gösterir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal dokunmanın yokluğunu ya da yasağını kalıplaşmış biçimde bildirir; komşu dal ise dokunmanın gerçekleşmesini ve duyusal algıyı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Karşılıklı dokunma olumsuzlanır, reddedilir veya yasaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Fiziksel dokunma ve dokunma duyusuyla algılama olumlu olarak gerçekleşir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da kişiler veya nesneler arasındaki fiziksel dokunma eksenine dayanır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: لا مساس أي لا مماسة (ayn)؛ لا مساس أي لا أمس ولا أمس (sihah)؛ لا مساس أي لا يمس بعضنا بعضا (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, olumsuz kalıbı karşılıklı dokunmanın reddi veya birbirine dokunmama bildirimi olarak açıklar.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التعبير لا مساس وما في معناه من نفي المماسة أو امتناع أن يمس بعضهم بعضا.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست كناية النكاح، ولا مس الجنون، ولا مجرد اسم مصدر خارج الصيغة.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir işin öğeleri birbirinden seçilemeyecek biçimde karıştığında ve sonuçta kuşku doğduğunda genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Öğelerin karışmasını, ayırt edilemezliği ve bunun doğurduğu belirsizliği korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir işin öğelerinin birbirine karışarak ayırt edilmesi güç, kuşkulu ve belirsiz hale gelmesidir.

facets.statement: Bir işin parçaları veya yönleri birbirine karışır ve açıkça ayırt edilemez olur.
Karışma sonucunda iş kuşkulu ve belirsiz görünür.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Karışıklığın bir işi anlamayı veya çözmeyi güçleştirdiği anlatı bağlamlarında doğal açıklayıcı karşılıktır.

error_profile.adds: Çözüm bulamama sonucunu, kaynak çekirdeğinde zorunlu olmayan ölçüde belirginleştirir.
error_profile.preserves: Karışıklığı, belirsizliği ve işin ayırt edilip çözülmesindeki güçlüğü korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal fiziksel dokunmayı değil, bir işte ortaya çıkan karışıklık, kuşku ve belirsizliği kapsar.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak sözü, ilgili biçimlerin bir işin karışmasını, birbirine benzer öğeler yüzünden ayırt edilemez hale gelmesini anlattığını tutarlı biçimde verir.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: işin karışıp kuşkulu veya belirsiz hale gelmesi

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak dalın karışma ve belirsizleşme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; başka dallardaki kalıba bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; aynı iş karışıklığı çekirdeğine en çok yaklaşan ve ek bir bocalama görünümü taşıyan dal seçildi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çekirdekleri yakındır; komşu dal karışıklık içinde dönüp durmayı ayrıca öne çıkarırken bu dal karışma ve kuşkulu belirsizlikle sınırlıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal, ilgili biçimlerle bir işin karışıp kuşkulu veya belirsiz hale gelmesini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, karışıklık içinde dönüp durma ve çıkış yolu bulamama görünümünü ayrıca taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir işin karışıp açıkça ayırt edilemez hale gelmesini anlatır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: المسمسة والمسماس اختلاط الأمر واشتباهه (ayn)؛ المسمسة اختلاط الأمر والتباسه والاسم المسماس (sihah)؛ المسمسة اختلاط الأمر واشتباهه (tahdhib)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, biçimleri bir işin karışması ve bu yüzden kuşkulu ya da belirsiz hale gelmesi üzerinde birleştirir.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه المسمسة والمسماس بمعنى اختلاط الأمر واشتباهه أو التباسه.
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس اللمس الحسي ولا النكاح ولا مس الجنون.

root_profile.summary: Kökün anlam alanı fiziksel dokunmadan cinsel birleşme ve akıl yitimi için örtülü anlatımlara, etkiye uğramaya, yakın hısımlığa, ivedi gereksinime, bir su adına, dokunma yasağına ve karışık belirsizliğe uzanır. Bazı dallar dokunma imgesi çevresinde anlamca bağlanırken su adı ve karışıklık gibi kullanımlar ayrı sözlüksel odaklar oluşturur.

lu_001.text: bir şeye elle dokunmak veya onu dokunarak algılamak

lu_020.text: oyuncunun ötekinin bedenine dokunmasıyla oynanan oyun

lu_008.text: cinsel birleşme için kullanılan karşılıklı dokunma anlatımı

concept_gloss.text: iyi veya kötü etkinin kişiye ya da mala erişmesi

lu_013.text: malında iyi iz ve sonuç bırakma

concept_gloss.text: ellerin ulaşabildiği, tatlı-tuzlu arası ya da susuzluğu gideren su

lu_018.text: işin karışıp kuşkulu veya belirsiz hale gelmesi

concept_gloss.applicability: Yasaklayan kişi, engellenen kişi ve karşılıklı engelleme yapılarını kapsayan genel kavram karşılığıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Yasaklama, engelleme ve geri durma yönlerinin tümünü korur.

concept_gloss.text: bir eylemi yasaklama, engelleme veya ondan geri durma

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseyi bir eylemden yasaklayarak, engelleyerek veya uyararak alıkoymak; ilgili yapılarda yasaklanan eylemden geri durmak ya da insanların birbirini kötülükten alıkoymasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir eylemin yapılmasını yasaklama, engelleme veya caydırma yoluyla durdurma.
Yasaklanan veya istenmeyen eylemden geri durma ve kendini tutma.
Bir topluluğun kötülük karşısında üyelerini karşılıklı olarak engellemesi.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişiyi belirli bir eylemden men ettiği etkin kullanımda uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Kişinin kendiliğinden geri durmasını ve karşılıklı engellemeyi kapsamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Etkin yasaklama ve engelleme hareketini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek anlam eylemi durdurmaya yöneliktir; bitiş noktası, akıl veya su birikintisi anlamları bu dala girmez.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir eylemi yasaklayıp engelleme ile kişinin yasaklanan şeyden geri durmasını ve insanların kötülükten birbirini alıkoymasını birlikte doğrular.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, yalın yasaklama anlamını korur; vazgeçme, benliği tutma ve karşılıklı engelleme yalnızca kanıtlanan yapılara bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; azarlama, sesle durdurma ve yasak statüsü en açıklayıcı sınırları verdi, diğerleri yalnızca uzak tema veya başka iç dallarla ilişki gösterdi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği genel yasaklama ve geri durmadır; komşu dal ise engellemenin azarlama biçimini daha belirgin taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yasaklanan eylemden geri durmayı ve insanların birbirini karşılıklı olarak engellemesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Azarlama ve sertçe geri çevirme biçimini özellikle öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da bir davranışı önlemeye ve kişiyi o davranıştan döndürmeye yönelir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dalda sesli azarlama kurucu bir özelliktir; odak dalda yasaklama ses biçimine bağlı değildir.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Sesli bir çıkış gerektirmeyen yasaklama, kendini tutma ve karşılıklı engelleme kullanımlarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Sesle azarlama, kovma veya hayvanı ve başka varlıkları sesle yöneltme kullanımlarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisi de bir hareketi durdurmak için caydırıcı müdahaleyi anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal yasaklama eylemidir; komşu dal ise eylemin yasak statüsünü ve izin verilmezliğini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Birini eylemden alıkoyma hareketini ve o eylemden geri durmayı bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyin yapılmasının hükmen veya dokunulmazlık bakımından yasak oluşunu bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da yapılmaması gereken davranışlar alanındadır.

branches.source_phrase_ar: النهي خلاف الأمر (ayn;sihah)؛ النهي الزجر عن الشيء (mufradat)؛ نهيته عنه فانتهى عنك (maqayis;sihah)؛ وتناهوا عن المنكر أي نهى بعضهم بعضا (sihah)؛ ما تنهاه عنا ناهية أي ما تكفه عنا كافة (ayn)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıtlar, buyruğun karşıtı olan yasaklamayı, bir şeyi yaptırmamak için engellemeyi ve bunun sonucunda geri durmayı aynı çekirdek çevresinde birleştirir; karşılıklı engelleme bu çekirdeğin topluluk içindeki kullanımını gösterir.

branches.what_is_ar: النهي عن الشيء والزجر عنه وكف الفاعل أو انكفافه وتناهي الناس عن المنكر
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست غاية الشيء ولا الغدير ولا العقل المسمى نهى

concept_gloss.applicability: Son sınır çekirdeği ile ulaştırma uzantısını birlikte anlatır; özel bağ ucu kullanımı bağlamda ayrıca belirtilir.

error_profile.preserves: Son nokta ile hedefe ulaştırma arasındaki yönlü bağı korur.

concept_gloss.text: son noktaya varma veya bir şeyi hedefine ulaştırma

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin ilerleyişinin veya uzanışının vardığı son nokta ya da sınırdır; ilgili yapılarda bir haberin veya okun hedefe ulaştırılmasını, özel bir kullanımda da devenin burun bağının ucunu bildirir.

facets.statement: Bir şeyin ulaştığı son nokta, uç veya sınır.
Haber veya ok gibi bir şeyi amaçlanan alıcıya ya da hedefe ulaştırma.
Devenin burnundaki bağın uç bölümü.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin kendi son noktasına vardığı bağlamlarda doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.loses: Bir şeyi alıcıya ulaştırma eylemini ve bağ ucunu dışarıda bırakır.
error_profile.preserves: Varılan son nokta ve hedef yönünü korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal genel son sınırı içerir, ancak ulaştırma eylemi ile belirli bağ ucu çekirdekle eş düzeyli bağımsız anlamlar sayılmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi şeyin ulaştığı son sınırı temel alır; haberin veya okun hedefe ulaştırılması bu çekirdeğin ettirgen uzantısı, burun bağının ucu ise somut ve dar bir uzmanlaşmadır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın son ve sınır anlamı ile yalnızca belirli yapılarda görülen ulaştırma ve bağ ucu kullanımları ayrı tutulur.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; en yakın son sınır dalları ile ayırıcı sınır yayımlandı, dip, yakınlık, su, akıl ve öteki iç dallar yalnızca farklı çekirdekler sundu.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Son sınır çekirdeği büyük ölçüde örtüşür; odak dal ulaştırma ve bağ ucu uzantılarıyla, komşu dal ise derece ve uzaklık kapsamıyla ayrılır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Haber veya oku hedefe ulaştırma ile belirli bir bağ ucunu adlandırma uzantılarını içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Kalite derecesinin en yüksek noktasını ve şeyin erişebildiği en uzak mesafeyi ayrıca kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin vardığı en son veya en uzak noktayı anlatır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal zaman ve mesafe boyunca uzanan sürecin sonuna odaklanır; odak dal daha genel son nokta yanında ulaştırma uzantısı taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bir şeyi alıcıya veya hedefe ulaştırmayı ve somut bir bağ ucunu da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Süre, ömür, vade ve yarış için belirlenmiş bitiş sınırını özellikle kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da şeyin sona vardığı sınırı adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal varış ve bitiş noktasını, komşu dal ise ayırma ve sınırlandırma işlevini temel alır.
neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: İlerleyişin vardığı son nokta ile hedefe ulaştırmayı anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: İki alanı ayıran çizgiyi, mülk sınırlarını ve aşılmaması gereken kuralları da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her ikisinde de bir şeyin ötesine geçilmeyen sınır düşüncesi bulunur.

branches.source_phrase_ar: النهاية الغاية حيث ينتهي إليه الشيء وهو النهاء (ayn)؛ نهاية كل شيء غايته (maqayis)؛ أنهيت إليه الخبر بلغته إياه (maqayis;mufradat)؛ الإنهاء الإبلاغ وأنهيت إليه الخبر فانتهى وتناهى أي بلغ (sihah)؛ النهاية طرف العران الذي في أنف البعير (ayn)

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kanıt, varılan son sınırı ana anlam olarak verir; bildirme ve gönderme yapılarında bir şeyi son hedefine ulaştırma, ayrıca belirli bir hayvan bağının uç kısmı bu uzanıştan türeyen kullanımlardır.

branches.what_is_ar: نهاية الشيء وغايته وطرفه وبلوغ الخبر أو السهم إلى المقصود والإبلاغ إلى المخاطب
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الزجر عن فعل ولا العقل ولا الغدير

concept_gloss.applicability: Davranışsal frenleme işlevinin kurucu olduğu bütün dal kullanımlarına uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Akıl, ayırt etme ve kötülükten alıkoyma işlevlerini korur.

concept_gloss.text: kötü davranışı önleyen akıl ve sağduyu

concept_map.definition: Kişinin kötü, çirkin veya uygunsuz davranışı ayırt edip kendini ondan alıkoymasını sağlayan akıl ve sağduyu yetisidir.

facets.statement: Kötü davranışı tanıyıp kişiyi onu yapmaktan alıkoyan akıl.
Bir kişide onu durduracak akıl veya iç engel bulunup bulunmadığını belirtme.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişide davranışını frenleyecek zihinsel yetinin bulunup bulunmadığı söylenirken uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Dalın genel akıl adı olarak kullanımını tek başına karşılamaz.
error_profile.preserves: Davranışı frenleyen sağduyu işlevini korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada yalnızca zihinsel yeti değil, davranışı frenleyen ayırt etme ve özdenetim işlevi kurucudur.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu dalı, sahibini çirkin ve uygunsuz davranıştan alıkoyan düşünme gücü olarak açıkça tanımlar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın adlandırmalar frenleyici aklı gösterir; bir kişide böyle bir engelleyici bulunmadığını söyleyen kullanım yalnızca kendi yapısına bağlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; tam örtüşen frenleyici akıl, daha geniş bilişsel akıl ve karşıt yetersizlik ekseni seçildi, diğerleri daha uzak zihinsel durumları gösterdi.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kanıttaki çekirdek ve davranışsal sınır aynıdır; yayımlanabilir bir anlam ayrımı görünmez.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yalnızca aktarım ile reddi birlikte gösteren sözlük tartışmasını özetlemek için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Nesne alanını ve adlandırmanın tartışmalı oluşunu birlikte korur.

concept_map.definition: Bazı sözlük aktarımında şişeleri veya cam eşyayı adlandırdığı söylenen, ancak başka bir aktarımda geçerliliği reddedilen tartışmalı bir addır.

facets.statement: Şişeler veya cam eşya için aktarılan adlandırma.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Anlamın kesinliğini onaylamadan yalnızca tarihsel sözlük aktarımını açıklarken uygundur.

error_profile.loses: Aktarımın başka bir kaynakça reddedildiğini tek başına belirtmez.
error_profile.preserves: Aktarılan şişe ve cam eşya alanını korur.

identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam doğrulanmış ve üretken bir yalın kullanım gibi sunulmamalı; aktarılan fakat geçerliliği konusunda uyuşmazlık bulunan adlandırma olarak sınırlandırılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi şişeler veya cam eşya için böyle bir adlandırmayı aktarır, fakat aynı kanıt içinde bu aktarımın açıkça reddedildiğini de bildirir; dal ancak tartışmalı bir sözlüksel kayıt olarak korunabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Sözlükselleşme çözülmemiştir; tanım yalnızca tartışmalı aktarımı kaydeder ve yalın kök anlamı varsaymaz.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; doğrulanmış cam-şişe alanı ve belirli büyük kap en yararlı karşılaştırmaları verdi, diğer kap türleri yalnızca ortak kullanım alanı paylaştı.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın sözlüksel geçerliliği uyuşmazlıklıdır; komşu dal nesne alanını doğrudan ve daha geniş biçimde adlandırır.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal belirli büyüklük ve biçimde bir kaptır; odak dal ise cam ve şişe alanındaki tartışmalı genel aktarımdır.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Büyük testi veya küp biçimindeki belirli bir kap türünü adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal sıvı veya başka madde koymaya yarayan kaplar alanında buluşabilir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem yalın yalnızlık ve ayrılık biçimlerini hem de belirli yapılardaki tek başına olma anlatımlarını kapsar; yapıya bağlı anlamlar yalın dala genellenmemiştir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Yalnız veya ötekilerden ayrı bulunulan durumu, bir hareket ya da sıralanma gerektirmeden anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: yalnız bulunma ve tek tek ayrılma

concept_map.definition: Bir sayısının saymanın başlangıcı ve ilk birimi olmasıdır; aynı sayısal temel, varlıkları birer birer ele almayı ve bir bütündeki tek parçayı göstermeyi de kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir sayısının saymanın başlangıcı ve ilk birimi olması.

Bir bütün içindeki tek bir parçanın sayısal birim olarak belirtilmesi.

text.arabic_uthmani: لَّقَدْ كَفَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ثَالِثُ ثَلَٰثَةٍۢ ۘ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَٰهٍ إِلَّآ إِلَٰهٌۭ وَٰحِدٌۭ ۚ وَإِن لَّمْ يَنتَهُوا۟ عَمَّا يَقُولُونَ لَيَمَسَّنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ

baseline.text: 'Allah üçün üçüncüsüdür' diyenler kesinlikle inkâr etmişlerdir. Oysa tek bir ilahtan başka ilah yoktur. Söylediklerinden vazgeçmezlerse içlerinden inkâr edenlere acı bir azap dokunacaktır.

findings.text: Parçalara ayrılan üçlü sayım, eşi ve ortağı bulunmayan tek oluşla bağdaşmaz.
Sınırlandırılmayan söz, sonunda acı veren cezanın bedensel temasına dönüşür.

activation_trace.role: The third-as-completer image supplies the positional mechanism of adding one member to two.
Unity without partner, division, or multiplication supplies the direct negation of membered deity.
The worshipped-deity image fixes the disputed count to the category of worship, rather than to three unrelated entities.

changed_reading.after: The ayah rejects placing Allah as a member or part inside any counted divine composite; the one deity is without partner or partition.
changed_reading.before: The ayah simply replaces the number three with the number one.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ثَالِثُ ثَلَاثَةٍ is directly corrected by إِلَهٌ وَاحِدٌ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ordinal image makes Allah a member who completes a counted set, while the unity branch denies partner, partition, and multiplication. The correction therefore rejects divine componenthood, not merely an incorrect total.

activation_trace.role: Saying as belief or school supplies the durable doctrinal stance behind both the initial and continuing speech.
Covering the truth supplies the functional effect assigned to the maintained proposition.
Cessation supplies a possible break in the mechanism, showing that persistence rather than bare historical utterance is at issue.

changed_reading.after: The ayah diagnoses a repeatedly maintained creed that covers unitary worship, while making cessation from that verbal practice a live possibility.
changed_reading.before: The ayah reports and condemns one erroneous sentence.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: قَالُوا and يَقُولُونَ frame the proposition, while كَفَرَ and كَفَرُوا repeat the diagnosis.
baseline_models.mechanism: The saying branch can denote an adopted doctrine, and the disbelief branch can denote covering truth. Repetition turns a single utterance into a maintained verbal creed whose continued circulation performs the covering.

activation_trace.role: The reached endpoint supplies the stopping threshold offered by the conditional.
An effect reaching a person supplies the crossing from proposition to experienced consequence.
Painful punishment specifies the adverse effect that reaches the persisting speakers.
The pain-causing quality makes the threatened contact experiential rather than merely juridical.

changed_reading.after: A conditional interval remains in which the utterance can reach its end before its painful consequence reaches the persisting disbelievers.
changed_reading.before: A generic punishment is announced for a false belief.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The conditional لَمْ يَنتَهُوا is followed by the emphatic لَيَمَسَّنَّ.
baseline_models.mechanism: One branch marks an endpoint at which motion stops; the other marks an effect reaching and touching its object. The warning creates a threshold: end the saying before its consequence crosses into felt contact.

activation_trace.role: The doctrinal-saying image anchors the social mechanism to what the focus speakers continue to maintain.
Cessation is the focus ayah's required interruption of that maintained speech.
The failed act of restraining supplies institutional nonintervention as an enabling condition.
Sinful saying as a maintained position links the earlier leadership failure directly to speech.
Failure to restrain one another broadens the missing brake from leaders to reciprocal communal correction.
The reprehensible thing that should be repelled supplies the object and purpose of communal restraint.

changed_reading.after: The saying persists through a communal loop that leaders and peers fail to interrupt, so the command to desist also exposes a social duty of correction.
changed_reading.before: Each speaker merely needs to revise a private doctrinal opinion.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus demand to stop saying is surrounded by failures of learned authorities to prohibit sinful speech and of a community to prohibit one another from reprehensible action. Continued doctrine becomes a social inhibition failure, not only an individual's uncorrected opinion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated prohibition failures around saying and wrongdoing; I infer that nonintervention enables the focus doctrine to persist. A live alternative is that 5:63 and 5:79 address other misconduct and only analogically illuminate 5:73.
structural_cues: 5:63 asks why religious authorities do not prohibit sinful saying.
5:79 repeats the reciprocal form: they did not prohibit one another from a reprehensible act.
5:73 places the same stopping root inside the consequence condition.

activation_trace.role: Third-as-completer anchors the proposed placement of a member inside the divine count.
Unity without partner or partition supplies the category boundary that the context tests.
Association with Allah explicitly names the operation that the focus's counted membership performs.
Sonship and attribution to an origin place the Messiah within human genealogy.
Eating supplies the recurring bodily act that marks creaturely dependence.
Taking and tasting food supplies the material object of that dependence.
Possession and power of disposal, here negated, supply a functional test for an object claimed as divine.

changed_reading.after: The triadic claim fails because it installs dependent embodied members inside deity, a category that the one deity cannot share or partition.
changed_reading.before: The triadic claim fails only because its arithmetic total is wrong.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent identification of Allah with the Messiah is named association; the next ayah locates the Messiah in human filiation and makes both him and his mother eat food, while the following ayah denies divine standing to what cannot control harm or benefit. These dependency tests revise the numerical baseline into a category test: dependent embodied beings cannot be constituent members of deity.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies association, human filiation, eating, and negated control; I infer that dependence disqualifies a proposed member from the divine category. Alternatively, these details may refute one specific identification without asserting a general doctrine of noncomposition.
structural_cues: 5:72 contrasts the identification claim with the Messiah's command to worship Allah, his Lord and theirs.
5:75 states that the Messiah and his mother both ate food.
5:76 asks about worshipping what does not control harm or benefit.

activation_trace.role: Covering or denying truth supplies the harmful state named at both ends of the focus ayah.
Cessation supplies the hinge by which the harmful covering can stop.
Covering misdeeds until their effect is removed reverses the root's direction from concealing truth to erasing fault.
Protective covering of sin and its effect supplies the offered destination immediately after the threat.

changed_reading.after: The ayah names a harmful covering but leaves a conditional route into repentance and a restorative covering that protects from the threatened effect.
changed_reading.before: Disbelief is a fixed label followed by an unavoidable sentence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same root that marks covering truth in the focus later names God's covering of misdeeds, and the immediate next ayah adds protective forgiveness. The warning therefore opens a reversible transition from culpable covering to restorative covering through cessation and repentance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite covering branches and the immediate repentance invitation; I infer a directional path from truth-covering through cessation to sin-covering. Alternatively, the shared covering image may be lexical resonance rather than a deliberately staged reversal.
structural_cues: 5:65 conditions divine covering of misdeeds on belief and guarding.
5:73 conditions painful contact on failure to desist.
5:74 immediately asks whether they will repent and seek forgiveness, then names God forgiving and merciful.

activation_trace.role: Saying as adopted belief anchors the focus consequence to a verbalized alignment rather than to noise alone.
The hearers' saying voices the opposite adopted stance, preparing the positive comparison.
Heart-settling affirmation supplies the content and inward alignment of their spoken response.
A result returning to the actor supplies the causal return assigned to their saying.
Uttered speech is explicitly named as the basis of the positive return.
Matching an act with its recompense generalizes the speech-to-consequence mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Spoken doctrine is performative alignment: one saying continues truth-covering toward painful contact, while recognized truth voiced as belief receives a matched return.
changed_reading.before: Punishment answers an abstract proposition held in the mind.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope's positive endpoint explicitly rewards hearers because of what they said. Return and recompense branches make speech accountable action. This mirrors the focus, where persisting in what is said carries a painful return; opposite utterances enact opposite alignments.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit positive causal link from saying to returned reward; I infer a deliberate negative-positive symmetry with the focus warning. A live alternative is that 5:85 rewards the recognized faith behind the words, not the utterance considered independently.
structural_cues: 5:83 records recognition followed by the utterance, Our Lord, we believe.
5:85 states that God rewarded them because of what they said.
5:73 likewise links failure to stop what is said with a specified consequence.

activation_trace.role: Truth-covering supplies the behavior that qualifies the threatened subset, rather than functioning as an undifferentiated ancestry label.
Moderation between extremes supplies an explicit counter-trajectory within the larger group.
Nearness supplies relational contrast to the hostile or persisting subgroup.
Affection supplies the positive social disposition of a differently responding subgroup.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies receptivity rather than persistence in the condemned saying.
Recognition by a mark supplies a cognitive reversal from covering truth to identifying it.
Heart-settling affirmation supplies the resulting alternative status within the named population.

changed_reading.after: The ayah targets those among the speakers who persist in truth-covering, while the context preserves moderate, receptive, and believing trajectories within the broader population.
changed_reading.before: The ayah condemns an entire religious population as one fixed block.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus restricts painful contact to the disbelievers among the speakers. Context repeatedly differentiates internal trajectories: a moderate community exists among them, and some who identify as Christians are near in affection, listen, recognize, and affirm belief. The subgroup marker is therefore operative rather than incidental.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated internal contrasts and the focus's منهم; I infer that the threat tracks persisting response rather than flattening every member of a named community. The alternative is that the pronoun's immediate antecedent is only the speakers, though even then it preserves a qualified subset.
structural_cues: 5:73 says the disbelievers among them, grammatically restricting the threatened class.
5:66 contrasts an upright community among them with many who act badly.
5:82-83 identify a Christian-labeled subgroup whose humility, hearing, recognition, and believing move in the opposite direction.

activation_trace.role: Saying as a doctrinal position anchors the path mechanism to the focus proposition.
The third-member construction supplies the doctrinal endpoint produced by the path.
Religion as obedience and submission supplies the domain in which the boundary is overrun.
Truth fixed to reality supplies the boundary that excess leaves behind.
Following as allegiance and succession supplies the social transmission step.
The inclination of desire supplies the directional pull behind that following.
Repeated deviation from guidance supplies both prior path dependence and its multiplying effect.

changed_reading.after: Third of three is also the verbal product of religious boundary overrun, desire-led succession, and a path that reproduces deviation through followers.
changed_reading.before: Third of three is an isolated logical error.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later prohibition of excess in religion, beyond truth, followed by desire and repeated straying, supplies a production sequence for the focus saying. The triadic formula can be read as the verbal endpoint of boundary overrun, inherited attachment, and directional loss rather than as a detached arithmetic mistake.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequenced excess-following-desire-straying chain; I infer that it causally generates and transmits the focus formula. Alternatively, 5:77 may diagnose a broader set of doctrines and practices rather than this saying alone.
structural_cues: 5:77 contains the branchless cue غ ل و as a direct prohibition of excess in religion.
The same ayah orders excess, truth, following desire, prior straying, causing many to stray, and renewed straying from the level path.
5:73 names the resulting counted proposition as something repeatedly said.

remaining_uncertainties: The indivisibility reading of one is branch-supported but may go beyond a narrower denial of partners.
The causal symmetry between the condemned saying and the rewarded saying may concern the dispositions voiced by speech rather than words independently.
The hearthstone, imposed-restraint, and split-root readings are live analogies but must remain explicitly exploratory.
strongest_changes: The numerical correction became a rejection of dependent members and partition within deity.
The demand to desist became a communal inhibition problem as well as an individual decision.
The warning became reversible through the pericope's competing images of truth-covering and restorative covering.
The explicit reward because of what responsive hearers said made the focus saying part of a matched speech-to-consequence structure.
The focus's among them became a decisive subgroup restriction in light of later moderate and receptive trajectories.
summary.what_was_special: The pericope repeatedly converted a compact theological proposition into inspectable mechanisms: counted membership, embodied dependence, failed social restraint, competing coverings, matched returns for speech, and differentiated responses within a named population.

activation_trace.role: The third hearthstone supplies a concrete image of one support being installed beside two to hold a cooking vessel.
Eating activates the domestic support image while marking the human figures' dependence.
Food supplies the material around which the hearth image coheres.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the claim installs Allah like a third support in a food-bearing human arrangement, sharpening the context's irony that the proposed human members themselves depend on eating.
changed_reading.before: The ordinal is only an abstract position in a theological count.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the third-hearthstone branch is a material idiom, not the ordinary propositional force of the phrase. It remains anchored directly to ث ل ث and is activated by the packet's immediate eating and food sequence. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, never as a translation or primary lexical claim.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ثَالِثُ ثَلَاثَةٍ permits the branch image of a third stone completing a three-support hearth.

activation_trace.role: Voluntary cessation supplies the restraint the speakers refuse to enact.
Withholding, preventing, or weaning supplies an imposed-restraint image nested behind the punishment term.
Pain-causing force keeps the exploratory restraint image subordinate to the explicit punitive sense.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, failure to accept voluntary restraint from the saying culminates in a painful form of imposed restraint.
changed_reading.before: Refused cessation and punishment are unrelated stages.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because restraint is a distant branch of ع ذ ب while punishment is the direct local branch. It remains anchored to the focus's paired cessation and punishment roots and forms a clean reversal. Downstream prose should qualify it as a secondary word-image, not redefine عذاب as restraint.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Failure to يَنتَهُوا is followed by عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ.

activation_trace.role: The split-root image of movement and lack of settledness supplies conceptual instability beneath the repeated saying.
Growth in number supplies the social amplification that can make an unsettled formula appear established.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, repetition among many may amplify a conceptually unsettled formula; social persistence can conceal instability rather than resolve it.
changed_reading.before: Repeated saying implies a stable and settled doctrine.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant ق و ل to ق ل ل mapping and is therefore form-distant from ordinary saying. It remains anchored to both occurrences of the focus root and gains a visible mechanism from the repeated context image of numerical manyness. Downstream prose should call it a split-root resonance about circulation and instability, not assign قلة as the verse's lexical meaning.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالُوا and يَقُولُونَ repeat the focus root around a compact counted formula.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Partitive counting is checked by peerless oneness.** `ث ل ث B002` is one third as a part, while `و ح د B003` is peerless uniqueness and `B004` God's exclusive oneness. I infer that the problem is not arithmetic complexity alone but treating the divine as a part within a divisible set.
2. **Unrestrained saying becomes bodily contact.** `ن ه ي B001` is restraint and `م س س B004` contact by an effect. Failure to stop speech leads to pain touching its speakers; I infer a movement from abstract formulation to embodied consequence.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Later ayah 5:120 made the fixed ayah's local distinctions newly visible as bounded operations within a single encompassing dominion, rather than as an isolated rule or episode.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Composed number is opposed to exclusive oneness.** Fixed **ث ل ث / B003** (“third or making a third”) and **B004** (“thing made of three parts”) structure the claim, while fixed **و ح د / B003** (“peerless uniqueness”) and **B004** (“God’s exclusive oneness”) deny peer-composition. 5:72 has already separated Lord and messenger in reported speech; 5:75–5:76 add bodily dependence and lack of independent disposal. I infer that a “third” presupposes a class of comparable units, whereas exclusive oneness blocks that operation. The rebuttal reads as a category correction, not a competing count within the same numerical set.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 5:75’s shared need to eat and 5:76’s negated disposal made exclusive oneness concrete rather than numerical only: the proposed comparable unit remained dependent.

words.gloss_range: oath particle prefixed to the verification particle; launches the verse as sworn certainty rather than neutral report
words.prose: {{ar:لَّ}} ({{tr:la}}) fuses the oath opening with the following verification particle, so the ayah begins as a sworn verdict before the quoted claim is even heard. It also sets the outer divine emphatic verdict against the inner human emphatic claim, joins the same surah-internal Christological adjudication sequence already heard at 5:17 and 5:72, and foreshadows the emphatic threat near the close.

topics.headline: sworn verdict launch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with oath-strength certainty and places that outer emphasis over against the quoted human assertion.
topics.reason: The oath particle is licensed by QAC as an oath opening before the verification particle, and the CRITICAL rows coherently tie that opening to verdict-first architecture and same-surah echo.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the ayah begins with judicial certainty, not neutral reportage.

words.gloss_range: verification particle before a perfect verb; confirms the completed reality of the verdict
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) makes the following perfect verdict grammatically verified as already realized. The reader should hear the condemnation as established before the speech content is quoted.

topics.headline: verified completed verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disbelief verdict is presented as settled before the quote unfolds.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as verification before the perfect verb, matching the CRITICAL claim.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the disbelief verdict is presented as settled before the quote unfolds.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect verdict verb; locally absolute and intransitive, naming culpable denial generated by the utterance
words.prose: {{ar:كَفَرَ}} ({{tr:kafara}}) is a Form I perfect verdict: the act is stated before the plural subject is unpacked, and the verb is left without an object, so the utterance itself creates the state of covering-denial. The root {{ar:ك ف ر}} ({{tr:k-f-r}}) returns near the punishment clause, binding speech, deity language, tactile contact, and pain into one chain from utterance to verdict to consequence; the opening formula also pairs with the denunciation at 5:17.
words.root_gloss_range: broad root field includes covering, denial, rejection, and ingratitude; local usage selects culpable denial while preserving covering pressure

topics.headline: absolute covering-denial verdict
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the statement is judged as culpable denial before any neutral paraphrase can take over.
topics.reason: The perfect Form I intransitive parse supports the verdict force, while lexical rows preserve covering-denial pressure without activating unrelated branches.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the statement is judged as culpable denial before any neutral paraphrase can take over.

topics.headline: opening and closing verdict frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same root binds the initial accusation to the threatened group near the end while the surrounding vocabulary links speech, deity language, contact, and pain.
topics.reason: The later plural verb in the punishment clause provides the concrete return of the same root.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the same root binds the initial accusation to the threatened group near the end.

words.gloss_range: relative pronoun functioning as subject of the verdict and introducing the speech-defined group
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) does not leave the accusation vague: it supplies the subject of the verdict and immediately defines that group by the following speech act. The same relative frame later reappears in the punishment object phrase, keeping verdict and consequence attached to the same speech-defined class, while the opening pattern also belongs with the parallel denunciations at 5:17 and 5:72.

topics.headline: speech-defined subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the condemned group is identified by what they say, not by an undefined label.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the relative pronoun the subject of the opening verdict with the following saying clause as its identifier.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the condemned group is identified by what they say, not by an undefined label.

topics.headline: relative frame echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening group frame returns in the threat and also participates in the repeated 5:17, 5:72, and 5:73 denunciation pattern.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL echo rows are coherent with the second relative pronoun in the apodosis.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the opening group frame returns in the threat, binding accusation and consequence.

words.gloss_range: Form I perfect speech verb introducing a complete quoted proposition
words.prose: {{ar:قَالُوٓا۟}} ({{tr:qālū}}) introduces a full quoted proposition, so the condemned material is the doctrinal claim as speech, not one isolated word. The perfect report is later answered by an imperfect speech verb, turning a past utterance into an ongoing condition to abandon; it enacts the kind of triadic saying forbidden by the "do not say three" command at 4:171 and stands alongside the parallel claim formulas at 5:17 and 5:72.
words.root_gloss_range: root field centers on saying and articulated speech; local usage selects doctrinal utterance as the culpable act

topics.headline: quoted doctrinal speech
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the offense is a proposition uttered as doctrine.
topics.reason: The verb governs a quotation block, and the speech-root rows correctly treat the utterance as doctrinal content.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the offense is a proposition uttered as doctrine.

topics.headline: past speech becomes ongoing liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah pairs the completed report with later ongoing saying as the thing to stop.
topics.reason: The later imperfect speech verb supplies the local anchor for the aspect shift.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the ayah pairs the completed report with later ongoing saying as the thing to stop.

topics.headline: anti-triadic speech field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this saying enacts the triadic speech forbidden at 4:171 and belongs with the repeated claim formulas at 5:17 and 5:72.
topics.reason: The rows give concrete references, especially 4:171 and 5:17, and the local quote is the same doctrinal field.
topics.summary: The reader notices that this saying participates in the Quranic correction of triadic speech (4:171).

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle inside the quoted speech; governs the inner nominal predication
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّ}} ({{tr:inna}}) marks that the speakers assert their own claim emphatically inside the quotation, governs the divine name as the subject of that inner clause, and sets up the ordinal predicate as the core error. The ayah therefore stages a clash of emphases: the outer sworn verdict condemns what the inner emphatic speech tries to establish.

topics.headline: inner emphatic claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the quoted claim is a controlled inner predication, with its own emphasis, subject, and ordinal predicate.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as governing the quoted nominal clause, and the CRITICAL rows correctly read it as inner assertion.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the quoted claim is asserted with its own emphasis, not reported as a loose slogan.

topics.headline: outer and inner emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rhetorical contest between divine verdict emphasis and human claim emphasis.
topics.reason: The opening emphatic frame and the inner particle are both locally present.
topics.summary: The reader notices the rhetorical contest between divine verdict emphasis and human claim emphasis.

words.gloss_range: proper divine name as the accusative subject of the quoted predication
words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:Allāha}}) is the named subject inside the condemned predication, so the claim is directly about Allah rather than a generic divine category. The correction then moves from this proper name to the common deity noun, letting worship, refuge, and bewilderment associations remain controlled background while denying every rival object of worship or refuge and affirming only one.
words.root_gloss_range: root field links divine name and deity language; local word remains a proper noun while the following correction broadens to deity category

topics.headline: proper name inside the claim
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the offense predicates the triadic role directly of Allah.
topics.reason: QAC marks the word as the governed subject of the quoted clause.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the offense predicates the triadic role directly of Allah.

topics.headline: proper name to deity category
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the refutation broadens from the named Allah to the whole deity category.
topics.reason: The later common deity nouns provide the local basis for the name-category contrast.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the refutation broadens from the named Allah to the whole deity category.

words.gloss_range: ordinal numeral as predicate and construct head; places the referent as member-position within a counted three
words.prose: {{ar:ثَالِثُ}} ({{tr:thālithu}}) is the predicate of the quoted clause and the construct head of the following cardinal, making the claim tighter than a free slogan about three. It assigns a member-position within a counted set, which the later oneness adjective directly overturns; the ayah reports as a genitive predicate formula the triadic speech warned against by "do not say three" at 4:171.
words.root_gloss_range: number root field centers on threeness; local phrase selects ordinal thirdness linked to a genitive counted set

topics.headline: ordinal construct predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the claim grammatically positions Allah as a member within a counted triad.
topics.reason: The ordinal is the predicate and construct head, so the CRITICAL rows about relational thirdness are locally licensed.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the claim grammatically positions Allah as a member within a counted triad.

topics.headline: three-one antithesis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse builds its central refutation as a number conflict: third-of-three against one.
topics.reason: The following oneness word and the 4:171 reference make the numerical opposition explicit.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the verse builds its central refutation as a number conflict: third-of-three against one.

words.gloss_range: indefinite cardinal in genitive construct relation; supplies the counted set for the ordinal
words.prose: {{ar:ثَلَٰثَةٍۢ}} ({{tr:thalāthatin}}) supplies the counted set governed by the ordinal and leaves that set indefinite. The payoff is that the ayah condemns the triadic configuration as such, without needing to name the members; its genitive form also contrasts with the nominative anti-triadic wording at 4:171.
words.root_gloss_range: number root field centers on threeness; local usage selects an indefinite three-set rather than a named list

words.gloss_range: resumptive conjunction opening the corrective assertion after the quote
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is the hinge from human assertion to divine correction. Everything before it is the condemned quotation; everything after it begins the monotheistic answer.

topics.headline: correction hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the exact turn from quoted error to corrective truth.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify this conjunction as resumptive at the quote-to-correction transition.
topics.summary: The reader notices the exact turn from quoted error to corrective truth.

words.gloss_range: negative particle beginning the strengthened negation-exception formula
words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens the corrective formula by beginning a categorical negation that will not stop at denial; it is designed to pass through exception into exclusive affirmation. The refutation therefore negates the whole deity class before affirming only one.

topics.headline: categorical negation to exception
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the correction works by exhaustive denial followed by exclusive affirmation.
topics.reason: The particle is locally part of the reinforced negation-exception construction, matching the CRITICAL rows.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the correction works by exhaustive denial followed by exclusive affirmation.

words.gloss_range: emphatic preposition inside the negative construction; widens negation over the class
words.prose: {{ar:مِنْ}} ({{tr:min}}) strengthens the negation rather than marking ordinary source. Its payoff is exhaustive scope: the clause denies any deity-instance before the exception is allowed.

topics.headline: exhaustive negation scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the negation leaves no secondary divine member available before the exception.
topics.reason: QAC marks the particle as emphatic within the negative construction, so the exhaustive-scope rows are locally supported.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the negation leaves no secondary divine member available before the exception.

words.gloss_range: common deity noun under emphatic negation; indefinite genitive gives class-wide force
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَٰهٍ}} ({{tr:ilāhin}}) is the deity category under exhaustive negation: not one possible object of worship or refuge is left standing. Its repetition after the exception makes the formula precise: the same category is first denied as a class and then affirmed only as one.
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes worship, refuge, and deity language; local usage selects common deity category under total negation

topics.headline: negated deity class

words.gloss_range: exception particle pivoting total negation into restriction
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّآ}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the pivot of the monotheistic formula: the prior total negation exists to arrive at a single permitted exception. The word turns denial into restriction rather than leaving the clause as bare negation.

topics.headline: exception pivot

words.gloss_range: affirmed common deity noun after exception; nominative and qualified by oneness
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَٰهٌۭ}} ({{tr:ilāhun}}) is the same deity category now standing after the exception as the sole affirmed instance. Its nominative position and following adjective make the correction positive and restrictive: deity is affirmed only as one, not as a member within a triad.
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes deity, worship, and refuge language; local usage selects the sole affirmed deity category

words.gloss_range: numeral adjective qualifying the affirmed deity; countable one directly answers the counted three
words.prose: {{ar:وَٰحِدٌۭ}} ({{tr:wāḥidun}}) grammatically qualifies the affirmed deity, so oneness is attached to the noun rather than floating as an aside. Its numerical force is tuned to answer the preceding three-field as countable singularity rather than only abstract uniqueness, and the same monotheistic formula appears in the anti-triadic correction at 4:171 before the verse turns to consequence.
words.root_gloss_range: root field centers on oneness and unity; local usage selects numerical singularity in direct contrast to threeness

words.gloss_range: second resumptive conjunction moving from correction to conditional warning
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the third movement of the ayah: verdict, correction, then conditional warning. The hinge matters because the threat follows a completed monotheistic correction and still leaves room for desistance.

topics.headline: warning hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah turning from doctrine into consequence without losing the possibility of return.
topics.reason: QAC marks this conjunction as resumptive before the conditional clause.
topics.summary: The reader notices the ayah turning from doctrine into consequence without losing the possibility of return.

words.gloss_range: conditional particle introducing possible non-desistance and its consequence
words.prose: {{ar:إِنْ}} ({{tr:in}}) makes the threat conditional rather than fatalistic: if they do not desist, the consequence follows. The word opens a mercy window after a severe verdict, holding possible escape and emphatic warning together.

topics.headline: conditional mercy window
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah gives a path of desistance after the verdict.
topics.reason: The conditional particle governs the protasis and is locally followed by negative jussive desistance.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the ayah gives a path of desistance after the verdict.

words.gloss_range: negative jussive particle making non-desistance the condition
words.prose: {{ar:لَمْ}} ({{tr:lam}}) negates the required act of stopping and governs the following jussive verb. The warning is therefore triggered by failure to cease the ongoing speech, not by an unspecified failure detached from the claim.

topics.headline: negative desistance condition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the threatened consequence depends specifically on not stopping.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as negative and jussive in the conditional protasis.
topics.summary: The reader notices that the threatened consequence depends specifically on not stopping.

words.gloss_range: Form VIII jussive desistance verb; demands self-stopping from the stated speech
words.prose: {{ar:يَنتَهُوا۟}} ({{tr:yantahū}}) is the demanded stopping-point: the speakers must bring their own utterance to an end. Form VIII gives the desistance an inward, self-prohibiting force, and 4:171 supplies the direct imperative counterpart to this conditional warning.
words.root_gloss_range: root field includes ending, forbidding, and desisting; local Form VIII selects self-involved cessation under conditional pressure

topics.headline: self-desistance from speech

words.prose: {{ar:عَمَّا}} ({{tr:ʿammā}}) binds the stopping to its object: what must be abandoned is what they are saying. The compound form compresses movement away from the doctrine with the relative content being uttered.

words.root_gloss_range: root field centers on saying and articulated speech; local imperfect marks ongoing doctrinal utterance

words.gloss_range: emphatic particle prefixed to the apodosis verb
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) opens the apodosis with assertion, and the following heavy emphasis on the verb completes the warning complex. The conditional path is real, but if non-desistance continues, the consequence is presented as certain.

topics.headline: emphatic apodosis

topics.summary: The reader notices that the consequence is not tentative once the condition is met.

words.gloss_range: Form I imperfect contact verb with heavy emphasis; punishment is the delayed grammatical toucher and the deniers are the touched object
words.prose: {{ar:يَمَسَّنَّ}} ({{tr:yamassanna}}) makes the threat tactile: punishment will touch the deniers, and the grammar makes punishment the actor rather than a passive thing received. The contact image is concrete and immediate, while the abstract punishment frame keeps it as punitive contact-language; parallels at 2:80 and 36:18 show the same touch-threat idiom.
words.root_gloss_range: root field centers on touching and contact; local punishment usage recruits tactile contact metaphorically and grammatically without requiring literal bodily touch by a physical agent

topics.summary: The reader notices that punishment is grammatically active, reaching the deniers as contact rather than remaining a vague consequence.
